    if form == 'square':
        return np.sign(np.sin(2*np.pi*freq*t))
    if form == 'saw':
        return 2*ph - 1
    if form == 'triangle':
        return 2*np.abs(2*ph-1)-1
    if form == 'pulse25':

    return np.sin(2*np.pi*freq*t)
